title: Talk it through 2.4
role: Guide telling a colleague what happened during a group visit
can_do: I can tell a past event with the past simple and the past continuous.
I can link ideas with while, when, but, so and although.

nodes.partner_line: What happened at the museum this morning?
nodes.translation: ¿Qué pasó en el museo esta mañana?

options.text: The power went out while we were visiting.
A group of students arrived late, so we waited.
Nothing special. We had a nice visit.

nodes.partner_line: What were you doing when the lights went out?
nodes.translation: ¿Qué estaban haciendo cuando se apagaron las luces?
nodes.model_reply: We were looking at the old maps.

options.text: No, although some people were scared.
One guest fell, but she is fine.

nodes.partner_line: How did you solve the problem?

options.text: We used our phones as flashlights.
The staff brought candles, so everyone stayed calm.
The guard opened the emergency door.

nodes.partner_line: Unfortunately the tour was shorter than planned. How did the guests react?
nodes.translation: Desafortunadamente el tour fue más corto de lo planeado. ¿Cómo reaccionaron los invitados?

options.text: They were disappointed, but they understood.
Most of them were happy, although a few were upset.
They said it was an adventure.

nodes.partner_line: Good. Please write a short report.
nodes.translation: Bien. Por favor escriba un informe corto.

options.text: I will write it this afternoon.
Of course. You will have it by five.

flags: Draft written for B1: a teacher must review the wording, the level and the answer keys before it is published.
